verdict.rationale: Remote documents official SDKs ('Introduction to Remote SDKs') that let partners embed workflows such as cost calculators and onboarding flows, either as custom UI or as drop-in components. Sample apps and boilerplate add some support, but the evidence shows only embedded-UI SDKs scoped to partner workflows, not general API client libraries. missing for 10: language-specific API client SDKs (e.g. Python/Node), SDK reference docs and versioning details, coverage of the full API surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: helps our partners embed Remote's powerful workflows (like cost calculators or onboarding flows) into their products in a matter of hours, not weeks.
You want a **drop-in flow experience** with the ability to customize the components to your design system
template architectures, boilerplate authorization loops, and sample apps you can clone or fork.
